youtube_title: Googled a Customer Care Number? The Top Result Can Be a Scammer. Scam of the Week #7 #Shorts
youtube_description:
SCAM OF THE WEEK #7. Your refund is stuck, you search for a customer care number and call the top result. The 'agent' asks you to download an app and pay a Rs 5 verification fee. A: send it. B: hang up.
Answer: B. Kerala Police warned in Oct 2026: don't trust customer care numbers from internet searches - scammers post fake ones. With a screen-sharing or remote-access app they can see your screen and read your OTP. Take helpline numbers only from the official app or website, never share OTP or PIN, and if you're scammed call 1930 or report at cybercrime.gov.in.
Source: Kerala Police advisory (PTI, 3 Oct 2026).
